meta.title: ₹20,000 mein sabse best camera phone kaunsa hai? Volt 12 vs Aria Note 5 vs Kite X

sentences.text: Hello doston, kaise ho aap sab?
Welcome back to the channel.
Agar aap channel pe naye ho toh channel ko subscribe kar lo aur bell icon dabana mat bhoolna.
Aaj ka video bahut special hai, kyunki bahut saare log comments mein pooch rahe the.
Toh chaliye shuru karte hain.
Par usse pehle, is video ka sponsor hai CloudVault, jo aapke saare photos ko safe rakhta hai.
CloudVault mein aapko 200 GB free milta hai pehle teen mahine ke liye, link description mein hai, use code TECH20 for discount.
Main khud CloudVault use karta hoon aur honestly bahut accha experience raha hai.
Toh doston, aaj hum baat karne wale hain teen phones ke baare mein jo ₹20,000 ke andar aate hain.
Pehla phone hai Volt 12, doosra hai Aria Note 5, aur teesra hai Kite X.
Pehle main aapko inke specs bata deta hoon.
Volt 12 mein 50 megapixel ka main camera hai, 8 megapixel ka ultrawide hai, aur 5000 mAh ki battery hai.
Aria Note 5 mein 108 megapixel ka main camera hai, 2 megapixel ka macro hai, aur 5500 mAh ki battery hai.
Kite X mein 64 megapixel ka main camera hai, 12 megapixel ka ultrawide hai, aur 4800 mAh ki battery hai.
Teeno phones mein 120 hertz ka display hai aur teeno mein fast charging milti hai.
Volt 12 ka processor thoda better hai, Aria Note 5 ka display sabse bright hai, aur Kite X sabse halka phone hai.
Aur haan, end tak dekhna kyunki end mein ek bahut bada surprise hai jo maine kisi ko nahi bataya.
Achha ek baat bataun, ye phones lene ke liye main pichle hafte market gaya tha.
Wahan itna traffic tha ki mujhe ek ghanta lag gaya, aur parking bhi nahi mil rahi thi.
Phir ek dukaan wale bhaiya ne bola ki ye phones online sasta milta hai, toh main wapas aa gaya.
Phir maine online order kiya aur teen din mein delivery aa gayi, packaging bhi achhi thi.
Box mein charger mil raha hai, case mil raha hai, aur ek chhota sa sticker bhi.
Toh ab baat karte hain camera ki, jiske liye aap ye video dekh rahe ho.
Daylight mein teeno phones ki photos maine ek hi jagah se li hain, ek hi time pe.
Volt 12 ki daylight photo mein colours natural hain aur detail bahut achhi hai, sky bhi blow out nahi hua.
Aria Note 5 ki photo thodi zyada saturated hai, greens bahut zyada green lag rahe hain, par Instagram ke liye log ise pasand karenge.
Kite X ki photo thodi soft hai, zoom karne pe detail kam dikhti hai, par dynamic range achha hai.
Ultrawide mein Volt 12 aur Kite X dono theek hain, par Aria Note 5 mein ultrawide hai hi nahi, sirf macro hai jo honestly kaam ka nahi.
Ab portrait mode dekhte hain.
Volt 12 ka edge detection sabse accurate hai, baal ke around bhi cutout clean hai.
Kite X ka portrait thoda artificial lagta hai, background blur bahut zyada hai.
Aria Note 5 ka portrait theek thaak hai, skin tones thode warm hain.
Ab main aapko ek baar phir specs yaad dila deta hoon.
Volt 12 mein 50 megapixel ka main camera hai, 8 megapixel ultrawide hai, aur 5000 mAh battery hai.
Aria Note 5 mein 108 megapixel ka main camera hai, 2 megapixel macro hai, aur 5500 mAh battery hai.
Kite X mein 64 megapixel ka main camera hai, 12 megapixel ultrawide hai, aur 4800 mAh battery hai.
Toh specs ke hisaab se Aria Note 5 sabse aage lagta hai, par megapixel hi sab kuch nahi hota.
Ab aate hain low light pe, jo sabse important test hai.
Raat ko street light mein maine teeno phones se same shot liya.
Volt 12 ka night mode sabse clean hai, noise kam hai aur light sources flare nahi kar rahe.
Aria Note 5 mein noise zyada hai, aur 108 megapixel hone ke bawajood detail smudge ho gayi hai.
Kite X ka night mode brightness toh deta hai, par photo washed out lagti hai.
Indoor low light mein bhi Volt 12 hi aage hai, khaana aur faces dono natural dikhte hain.
Toh doston bas itna hi tha aaj ke video mein, umeed hai aapko pasand aaya hoga.
Achha ruko, video recording ki baat toh reh gayi.
Volt 12 mein 4K 30 fps recording hai aur stabilisation achha hai, chalte hue bhi video smooth hai.
Aria Note 5 mein sirf 1080p 60 fps hai, aur stabilisation average hai.
Kite X mein 4K hai par stabilisation sirf 1080p pe kaam karta hai.
Selfie camera mein Kite X sabse achha hai, 32 megapixel ka sensor hai aur skin tones natural hain.
Volt 12 ka selfie theek hai, Aria Note 5 ka selfie thoda beauty filter wala lagta hai.
Ab final verdict.
Agar aapko overall best camera chahiye, especially low light aur video ke liye, toh Volt 12 lo.
Agar aapko Instagram ke liye punchy colours aur sabse badi battery chahiye, toh Aria Note 5 dekh sakte ho.
Aur agar selfies aapki priority hai aur halka phone chahiye, toh Kite X best hai.
Mera personal pick Volt 12 hai, kyunki ₹20,000 mein iska camera sabse consistent hai.
Comment mein batao aap kaunsa phone loge, aur video pasand aaya ho toh like kar do.
Milte hain agle video mein, tab tak ke liye bye bye.

fixes.title: Open on the hook
fixes.rationale: Lead with the reason to stay; greetings can come after the viewer is committed.

fixes.title: Tease the answer in the first 15 seconds
fixes.rationale: Prove the title's question will be answered, then make them wait for the detail.

ops.new_text: Video ke end tak aapko clear ho jayega kaunsa jeetta hai, aur result ne mujhe bhi surprise kiya.
ops.note: Tease the answer to the title in one line, early.

fixes.title: Move the ask after the first payoff
fixes.rationale: Viewers who just got value are the ones who subscribe.

fixes.title: Move the sponsor read after the first payoff
fixes.rationale: Viewers who just got value are the ones who subscribe.

fixes.title: Turn the wrap-up into a bridge
fixes.rationale: Signal more is coming instead of an ending.

ops.new_text: Par abhi khatam nahi hua, jo cheez actually decide karegi woh abhi baaki hai.
ops.note: Turn the wrap-up into a bridge to what's still coming.

fixes.title: Close the loop or cut the tease
fixes.rationale: Every tease needs a visible payoff.

ops.note: Either pay it off explicitly later, or remove the tease.
